headline: Expanse Line Shifts as Heavy Fighting Sweeps Four Sectors
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has shifted again since the last edition, its tally now one Warden post, seven Colonial and one unclaimed, against the four Warden and five Colonial reported earlier; nine events were logged there in the past two hours and thirty-nine across the day, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk the busiest. Nevish Line now stands six Warden to two Colonial, its Blackcoat Way alone accounting for twelve filings. Stlican Shelf reads two Warden, six Colonial and one ruined post, Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town together supplying twenty-eight events in the day. Those three sectors furnished twenty-one of the twenty-nine events filed map-wide in the last two hours. Callahan's Passage holds at eight Warden to two Colonial but has gone quiet, its latest filing before noon. Kuura Strand filed four events at the cutoff hour around Talven, leaving five Warden posts and one unclaimed; Fisherman's Row logged three at Black Well and Palantine Berm one. Linn Mercy remains wholly Colonial at eleven posts, Mooring County wholly Warden at twelve. Casualty ledgers run heaviest in the Weathered Expanse, Nevish Line, Stonecradle, Stlican Shelf and Callahan's Passage. No victor has been declared.
